community_algorithm: Louvain on hand-labelled entity co-occurrence; not Leiden

summaries.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a parametric sequence-to-sequence generator with non-parametric memory retrieved from a dense index of Wikipedia passages.. RAG-Sequence conditions on the same retrieved passage for the whole output sequence; RAG-Token can condition on different passages at each token..

GraphRAG addresses global sensemaking questions about themes across a complete corpus that isolated nearest-neighbor passages may not cover.. GraphRAG derives an entity knowledge graph, organizes related entities into communities and prepares community summaries before query-time synthesis..
HNSW assigns an exponentially decreasing number of vectors to higher graph layers. Larger ef search beams typically improve approximate nearest-neighbor recall at a latency cost.

BM25 lexical retrieval scores exact query terms with inverse document frequency, saturated term frequency and document-length normalization.. Reciprocal rank fusion adds one over k plus the one-based rank of a document in each candidate list.
Retrieved documents are untrusted evidence. An associative archive lets an assistant remember relevant past facts by matching meaning rather than requiring identical wording..
A service manual lists component identifiers and maintenance schedules. The cooling assembly serial code XQ-17B-904 uses the Beryl coolant loop.

limitation: Extractive community summaries and fixed entity labels; no LLM entity extraction or global generative map-reduce.
